notes: WIS-710 synthetic engineering-authored regression measurements, qualified=false. No independent labeling or full blind model qualification. The independent reviewer audited the earlier implementation/evidence but did not call the model.

Counts measure the whole Go/model pipeline. Three missing-input sentences are deterministic server text; one conflict statement is model text based on an explicitly contradictory fixture. Do not interpret four actionable needs_input outputs as four model-written questions.

Labels and split were frozen before tuning. The first heldout read was after eb00d346 (v9). Later heldout reruns, including this review follow-up, are verification on an already evaluated set; heldout cases are structural near-copies of dev cases.

Baseline production is 94dba219; its harness was uncommitted and lacked a patch digest. Initial v13 measured production is 06c8ba2c. The final review replay uses the clean tracked production SHA in each after row. Prompt remains wisnew-investigation-13 because instructions/schema are unchanged; tool provenance is wis614-tools-7.

Only labels were frozen, not a hashed harness. Prior additions strengthened task-description checks; review changes remove prefix credit and report server authorship. The requested needs_input fallback changes an outcome expectation while keeping no-unvalidated-artifact assertions.

Wall-clock latency covers Runtime.Investigate including tokenization, tools and database persistence, excluding test setup and model-lock wait. Shared GPU/CPU/cache effects are uncontrolled. The server was externally restarted between early historical runs. These are measurements, not an isolated speed benchmark.

Historical two-of-four SCHEMA_INVALID responses were not retained; exact fields remain unknown. Fresh baseline and final schema rates are separate. V10 interrupted failures and all intermediates remain in private evidence.

Final direct clarifications have Go-written rationale. Earlier raw model responses with approximate quantities or clipped reason codes remain historical evidence; their text is no longer copied into the persisted clarification rationale.
Raw diagnostics, RED/green logs and credentials remain untracked. The JSON includes only synthetic artifacts and report metadata. No push, PR, merge, deployment or Linear write.

changes: Preserve direct needs_input/original reasons when Judge refuses its Go-built clarification; store no rejected artifact.
Remove the Supervisor prefix. The exact 495-rune probe now fits and is validated/stored unchanged; the digit probe remains needs_input with no artifact. Neither creates an action.
Use a Go-written clarification rationale instead of persisting model number words.
Assert the actual per-run ResponseSchema; the always-maintenance mutation now fails.
Bump ToolVersion to wis614-tools-7; rename branch/tests to WIS-710.
Strip the historical prefix before checking for a human role and record question authorship.

question_attribution.server_behavior: At v13 and after review, grammar forces exact missing keys from Go state; Go writes the question sentence and names the supervisor. Model chooses needs_input/refused/failed. These three are not model question-writing successes.
question_attribution.model_behavior: The model reports a conflict already explicitly stated in the source. This does not show independent conflict discovery; labels and human-role regex can match that planted source sentence.
question_attribution.historical_prefix: At v13 the Go Supervisor prefix made the human-role check pass for any question; removed in the review fix. The rerun strips it before checking even if it reappears.
question_attribution.v9_caveat: In the first blind v9 run, the model selected two exact missing keys later rendered by Go. dev-no-stop used model text that named no human and passed only because of the prefix; the conflict output included duplicated/off-target questions.
question_attribution.human_check_limit: Role-word presence is a limited string check, not proof that the model independently assigned responsibility.

generation_limits.maintenance_unknowns: The grammar forces required=false; Judge REQUIRED_INPUT_MISSING for required maintenance unknowns cannot fire on grammar-constrained maintenance output. Go still checks arbitrary provider output; this guard was not exercised by those constrained successes.
generation_limits.zero_known_gaps: missing_required_fields has maxItems=0, so the model cannot add other missing keys. Other uncertainty must stay in non-maintenance choices or genuine contradiction reporting.
generation_limits.hosted_strict_schema: Long regex acceptance/enforcement under hosted strict:true was not tested.
generation_limits.number_words: The observed direct-clarification rationale leak is removed by a Go-written rationale. No general number-word detector was added to arbitrary model prose.
